toegepas.voor: Baie kieme maak niemand siek nie en net sommige
toegepas.na: Baie kieme maak niemand siek nie, en net sommige
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb; the protected word is untouched.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Baie kieme maak' / 'net sommige kan maak').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both halves are full clauses, so the AWS 2017 comma is required; the protected word is untouched.

toegepas.voor: Die ding dra jou vel se kieme oor
toegepas.na: So 'n ding dra jou vel se kieme oor
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die ding' has no single antecedent after 'Party goed'; 'So 'n ding' refers back to any of those things.
toegepas.fout: 'Die ding' is singular and definite with no antecedent after the plural 'Party goed'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'So 'n ding' refers cleanly back to any of the things just named without changing the claim.

toegepas.blok: Waar kieme in die huis uitbroei
toegepas.voor: Kieme is lewende dinge en hulle het
toegepas.na: Kieme is lewende dinge, en hulle het
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses (own subject and verb); the protected word is untouched.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses ('Kieme is' / 'hulle het').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Each half has its own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 comma belongs there; the protected word is untouched.

toegepas.blok: Waar kieme in die huis uitbroei
toegepas.voor: Selfs 'n plek wat skoon lyk kan
toegepas.na: Selfs 'n plek wat skoon lyk, kan
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma after the embedded relative clause separates the two verbs 'lyk' and 'kan' and makes the sentence easier to read.
toegepas.fout: The verbs 'lyk' and 'kan' collide after the embedded relative clause, which makes a Grade 4 reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma closes the relative clause as the AWS allows and makes the sentence easier to read without changing anything.

toegepas.blok: Plekke om in die oog te hou
toegepas.voor: krane wat almal se hande vat
toegepas.rede_vinder: As written the handles and taps grab everyone's hands; 'waaraan almal vat' says that everyone touches them.
toegepas.fout: 'krane wat almal se hande vat' says the taps grab everyone's hands, not that everyone touches them.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'waaraan almal vat' says what was meant, that everyone touches them, and is plain Grade 4 Afrikaans.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'lank genoeg' introducing a result clause takes 'sodat' in standard Afrikaans.
toegepas.fout: 'lank genoeg dat' copies English 'long enough that'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'lank genoeg sodat' is the natural Afrikaans link to the result clause and the instruction is unchanged.

toegepas.blok: Wat soet kos aan jou tande doen
toegepas.na: As dit baie kere gebeur, kom daar
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Na baie kere' lacks a subject for what happens many times; the clause makes the repetition clear without adding content.
toegepas.fout: 'Na baie kere' is wooden: it does not say what happens many times.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The clause names the repetition of the acid attack just described, reads naturally and adds no content.

toegepas.blok: Wat soet kos aan jou tande doen
toegepas.voor: Hoe dikwels jy soet goed eet tel net so swaar soos hoeveel.
toegepas.na: Hoe dikwels jy soet goed eet, tel net so swaar soos hoeveel jy eet.
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma after the subject clause separates 'eet' and 'tel', and the elliptical 'soos hoeveel' needs its verb to be clear for Grade 4.
toegepas.fout: The verbs 'eet' and 'tel' collide with no comma, and the elliptical 'soos hoeveel' is hard for a Grade 4 reader to parse.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma and the completed 'hoeveel jy eet' make the comparison readable on a first pass with the same meaning.

toegepas.blok: Wat soet kos aan jou tande doen
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma after the embedded relative clause separates the two verbs 'suig' and 'hou'.
toegepas.fout: The verbs 'suig' and 'hou' collide after the embedded relative clause.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma closes the relative clause, consistent with change 5, and makes the sentence easier to read.

laat_vaar.voor: Hulle loop soms ook van 'n gedeelde kam, haarborsel of pet af.
laat_vaar.na: Hulle kom soms ook van 'n gedeelde kam, haarborsel of pet af.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'loop van ... af' reads as walking off something; 'kom van ... af' is the natural way to say where lice come from, and 'soms' is kept.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'loop' deliberately echoes the previous sentence and keeps that lice crawl; 'kom' loses that sense and is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.na: en nadat jy die toilet gebruik het
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'na die toilet' is clipped speech; the full clause is clearer and parallels 'voor jy eet'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'na die toilet' is ordinary, natural Afrikaans for this instruction; the longer clause only reads differently.

laat_vaar.voor: wanneer jy by die huis kom
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'tuiskom' is the natural verb for arriving home; 'by die huis kom' sounds translated.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Drico prefers the plain 'by die huis' over 'tuis' forms for a Grade 4 reader, so this is a move away from his bar.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'saam met 'n ete' is the more natural phrase for eating something together with a meal.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'by 'n ete' is natural Afrikaans for at mealtime, and 'saam met' is a lateral swap that slightly shifts the sense.
